name: NCC RVCE
description:
The National Cadet Corps (NCC) is a youth development organisation under the Ministry of Defence, Government of India, aimed at building character, discipline, leadership, and a spirit of service among young citizens. Guided by its motto "Unity and Discipline," NCC operates across schools and colleges nationwide through its Army, Naval, and Air Force wings.

The NCC unit at RVCE gives students a platform to build discipline, leadership, and teamwork alongside academics. Cadets train in drill, physical fitness, weapon handling, map reading, and field craft, and take part in camps, ceremonial parades, and community initiatives throughout the year.

Cadets get hands-on leadership experience by organising events, coordinating teams, and managing activities such as Shooting, Battle drill, and other such events which involves planning, outreach, and execution. Cadets get the opportunity to represent RVCE at prestigious national platforms like the Republic Day Camp (RDC), Thal Sainik Camp (TSC) and other state or national-level camps, building confidence and discipline alongside cadets from across the country.

Under the guidance of Lt. Dr. Ajay K M, Associate NCC Officer, NCC RVCE gives students the opportunity to go beyond academics, building leadership, discipline, teamwork, and a strong sense of service while embracing the spirit of "Unity and Discipline."
